roleNote: An example of what you can build from kit components. Start from it, change it, or ignore it; layout is your choice. Follow `must` (kit look and accessibility); `defaults` are this example's suggestions, change any of them.
copyNote: Not exported from agentic-ds-kit. add copies the source into your app (components/patterns/integration-settings/) with this contract beside it. You own the copy: replace the demo data, rearrange or drop sections, and keep the `must` lines.
intent: Settings block for one connected integration: status, sync settings in a FieldSet, granted scopes, Save, and Disconnect behind a danger AlertDialog.
must: Use kit components from agentic-ds-kit for anything the kit has; no local cousins (tables, dialogs, rows, rules, charts)
Semantic tokens only (agentic-ds-kit/tokens.css); no raw hex, no primitive --color-* ramps
At most one appearance="solid" mode="primary" Button per view
Do not restyle kit components; change them through their props, slots, and tokens
Wrap every setting in Field (label, hint and control wiring); group them in a FieldSet
Disable the FieldSet while saving and while access needs reauth
Disconnect is a danger action and confirms with a kit AlertDialog; Cancel returns focus to Disconnect
Connection status is a word in a kit Badge; syncing, error and expired access are kit Alerts
When access expires, Reconnect is the solid primary and Save steps down to outline

Render inside a main landmark (wrap the pattern, or your page content, in <main>); header and nav chrome, if any, use AppHeader / SideNav (or other header / nav landmarks) and nav stays reachable on small screens
defaults: Section with the provider name, last sync as its description, and the status Badge plus Sync now in its actions
Settings rows use Field labelPosition="start" (label left, control right)
Save changes submits the form; ⌘/Ctrl+S saves too
Scopes are kit Tags; Disconnect sits in a small Card at the end
Not connected shows a kit Empty with Connect
